summary: Traced NewRaft's startup configuration recovery and found that with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled the configuration scan starts after the committed prefix (api.go:611-613 after api.go:723-755), so a configuration entry existing only in the log is never applied to r.configurations when no snapshot carries it. Submitted a three-case in-process probe (RestoreCommittedLogs on/off with no snapshot, plus snapshot control) that predicts and locally reproduces the loss: the restarted single-voter node reports zero servers, logs 'no known peers, aborting election' and never campaigns again, while both controls keep the configuration and re-elect. Recorded a gap for the follow-on question of a committed configuration change that post-dates the snapshot.
